Suggested wording (150 words): We tested your decision that a new site's extra link can switch off before it is written. The rules already allow it: any link can turn off. But a link has two ends, so the extra unit does not vanish; it moves to the old neighbour and stays or wanders until it meets a partner. That helps one thing gravity needs: unwritten new sites now look empty to gamma. It does not set how much gets written; that still depends on how fast each new site is written compared with how fast growth points build. With each new site written about 300 times more slowly than a growth point builds, about 12% of grown sites end up written. Even then, gamma's paths in the grown network broke into small strand-like pieces, unlike in a ready-made 3D block at the same share. So gravity stays open. One model family; checked once.
